name: Victini

abilities.name: Victory Star
abilities.text: Once during your turn, after you flip any coins for an attack of 1 of your {Fire} Pokémon, you may ignore all results of those coin flips and begin flipping those coins again. You can’t use more than 1 Victory Star Ability each turn.

flavor:
When it shares the infinite energy it creates,
that being’s entire body will be overflowing
with power.
